name: base-doorkey
task: Use the key to open the door, then reach the goal.
texts: The agent must eventually open the door.
The agent must eventually reach the goal.
The agent must reach the goal only after the door is opened.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&door_open) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!door_open) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&door_open) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&door_open, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!door_open, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&door_open, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
